tasks.title: VPS sessions in desktop and web
tasks.note: One VPS device view; native Mac catalog parity and Android paired-mTLS VPS replay/input/resize verified. Toolbar overflow corrected at phone width. Owning-kernel resize fencing patch passes real PTY test but is not live; upstream release checks and physical mobile IME acceptance remain.

tasks.title: Live device resource view
tasks.note: Implemented on isolated branch: device selection, live host/session/process measurements and virtual memory. Owner-only; remote collector upgrades and separately granted phone inventory remain open.

tasks.title: Reusable terminal package
tasks.note: Installable alpha package and independent two-workspace consumer implemented. Shared renderer/client/input used by DOT. Live TUI resize, control transfer and minimize/restore verified locally. Styled recovery, hosted relay and platform acceptance remain open.

tasks.title: Quiet, named sessions
tasks.note: Named sessions verified across browser, native Mac and Android. Compact controls, status dots, expandable progress; iTerm UI removed. Further accessibility and interaction refinement continues.

tasks.title: Session CPU and memory
tasks.note: Mac and legacy Mac session descendants measured, including Rocky. CPU per core and summed RSS with stale/unknown state. Old VPS needs a collector upgrade.

tasks.title: One signed desktop app
tasks.note: One stable-signed installed app reuses the supervised shared hub. Quit/reopen preserved sessions and browser connection. Old session services remain intact.

tasks.title: Reconnect without setup
tasks.note: Keystore/profile survive Android updates; hub identity and settings moved to durable storage with supervised startup. DHCP address discovery and reboot testing remain open.

tasks.title: Devices and their sessions
tasks.note: Mac, web and Android share the device catalog and real-session tabs. Host execution stays on Mac/VPS; each view has its own selected tab.

tasks.title: Activity shows what happened
tasks.note: Tool calls, how many ran between events, which repeated and which failed, read from the agent's own log with your consent. Today Activity only shows that output moved.

tasks.title: Phone runs the same app
tasks.note: Shared interface installed in the normal Android app. Mac and VPS sessions verified over Wi-Fi; IME commits and control-acquisition ordering repaired. Reconnect and interaction coverage continues.

tasks.title: Output pushed, not polled
tasks.note: Views ask for new output many times a second. Over the internet that is slow; the keeper should push it.

tasks.title: Installed app updates itself
tasks.note: A versioned runtime outside any build folder, replaced without disturbing running sessions.

tasks.title: Test agents on every device
tasks.note: A Gemini session on the VPS and a small model on the phone, to watch how agents persist, render and get recorded.

tasks.title: Pair devices without shared secrets
tasks.note: Nodes use one long-lived secret today. Move them to per-device keys and pairing, like the phone link.

tasks.title: Phone hosts sessions
tasks.note: The phone becomes a device with its own sessions, usable from the Mac and the web.

tasks.title: Decision cards with diagrams
tasks.note: Questions, a diagram, options and a recommendation you can answer with one tap, instead of reading terminal text.

tasks.title: Clipboard and file transfer
tasks.note: Across paired devices, explicit and consented.

tasks.title: Mesh, secret broker, worldlines, iPad, Windows
tasks.note: Kept in HANDOFF.md as requirements and research. None of it is built.

tasks.title: Tap to type, see who is typing
tasks.note: No take-control ritual. The device you type on keeps input until you type on another one.

tasks.title: Output labelled with its screen size
tasks.note: Removes resize glitches for watching views and most of the traffic a remote view would need.

tasks.title: Version and reload
tasks.note: The app shows its version, reloads on demand and updates itself when you pause typing.

tasks.title: Voice in DOT sessions
tasks.note: The app declares microphone use so dictation inside a session can ask macOS.

tasks.title: Activity as a live pane
tasks.note: Beside the terminal, newest first, tied to the selected session.

tasks.title: Dependable input
tasks.note: Regression coverage for IME commit handling and queued input order. Wrong-tab focus incident prompted guards; broader physical keyboard, paste and resize checks remain.
